title: Preserve free-time bars without inventing a meter
scope: Retain the authored FreeTime flag independently from numeric meter and define its effect on finalized score timing.
acceptance: Public results preserve the exact free-time bars in testdata/gp7/free-time.gp.
Document and test timing for free-time bars with different voice lengths; use pinned AlphaTab authored semantics as the reference.
A caller can toggle the flag and GP8/AlphaTab preserves it without changing adjacent fixed-meter bars.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Focused public, exact wire, meter-timing, post-parse edit, strict export, and pinned AlphaTab evidence.
Reproduced at masterBars[1].isFreeTime. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.

resolution: MeasureHeader.FreeTime now preserves the authored GPIF presence marker independently on every master bar. Import treats element presence as true without inheriting or interpreting text payloads. Non-pickup finalization continues to use exact numeric meter length even when free-time voice content is empty, shorter, or longer; only the existing opening anacrusis rule uses content. GP8 emits FreeTime exactly when true without a loss report. Focused fixture, timing, exact wire, Go reimport, post-parse edit, strict export, and pinned AlphaTab evidence covers the scoped behavior.
